# ================================================================
#  ABOUT WIKTOR (factual profile)
# ================================================================

Wiktor Jelen is a backend and platform engineer based in Krakow, Poland (EU citizen).

He works system-first: architecture, invariants and failure modes are defined before
implementation, and behaviour is verified through tests and explicit system constraints.

Background:
- Primary contributor to a large multi-tenant TypeScript platform (2026): Temporal.io
  orchestration, PostgreSQL row-level security with isolation tests enforced in CI,
  multi-stage GitHub Actions delivery, multi-provider LLM integration layer
- Architected a backend serving 450+ concurrent users for the Medical University of Silesia
- Open source author: PythonMetaTrader5, 42,000+ PyPI downloads, used against real capital
- Cross-cultural R&D experience (EU-China collaboration, Shenzhen)
- Security-focused engineering (OWASP Top 10, LDAP/AD IAM, JWT, tenant isolation)

Core skills:
- Backend & data: TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, Temporal.io, PostgreSQL, Redis, MySQL, FastAPI
- Platform & infrastructure: Linux, Docker, GitHub Actions, Nginx, AWS, Hetzner, CI/CD
- Security: PostgreSQL RLS, IAM, LDAP/AD, JWT, OWASP, TLS
- AI & automation: Claude / OpenAI / Gemini APIs, MCP, output evals, Flux/LoRA, Whisper
- Additional: React, Three.js, C++, embedded systems, Fusion 360

Independent R&D:
- Built the execution layer first: PythonMetaTrader5, an open-source order-execution
  library for MetaTrader 5 (42,000+ downloads)
- Now working a layer above it, in machine learning: evolutionary computation, where
  genetic algorithms breed and select trading strategies instead of them being
  hand-written. StrategyQuant X generates strategy populations; survivors are
  stress-tested for robustness before they go near real capital

All figures above are verifiable via the links on the site (GitHub, PyPI / pepy.tech).
